pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregularly shaped polygonal regions with stellate or lobed margins. Individual patches exhibit high-frequency edge angularity and sharp pixel-level gradients between the dark interior and light boundaries.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored negative space forming a complex topological graph. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial, with pathway thickness narrowing significantly at the closest vertices of adjacent patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude jagged 1D contour along the upper neck, visible as dark pixel spikes against the bright background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, dark avian silhouettes (oxpeckers) perched on the dorsal neck and upper shoulder regions.
